notes.title: Ezerath Mini Release
notes.notes:
What is Ezerath Mini?
Ezerath Mini will run through the areas of Ezerath's Last hope using a side scroll format. Playing Ezerath Mini should provide an experience that is more simple and will take less time to grind through the game.

When will Ezerath Mini be completed?
The DLC is already currently in development, I plan on releasing it as soon as its completed; This should be some point in February, but it might take a little longer.

Side Notes.
I originally planned to only release 1 DLC for the game, Ezerath Plus; I still do not plan on adding any extra DLC that effect the gameplay of Ezerath's Last Hope. I have decided however that some DLC that are spin-offs of the main game, that exists in unique worlds that are not a part of the main game, with their own save files, are acceptable to develop without stepping on the toes of people who have already purchased Ezerath Plus for an expansion of the main game. Any DLC developed in the future will purely be spin-offs. I do not want any new DLC's to be essential to experience all that Ezerath's World has to offer.

I will still be updating the main game, and Ezerath Plus. I don't want DLC development to become a priority; Ezerath Plus will remain the largest and the most expensive DLC.

Lastly, if you have any questions or concerns, please leave a comment, I will respond to all questions/comments.

notes.title: Update for 7/3c
notes.notes:
Buffs to damage and critical strike attribute points.

Part of the changes to hard mode compared to normal was reduced critical chance, but the numbers didn't make sense compared to building damage, by buffing damage and critical (in normal and easy mode), and taking away the buff to damage points in hard this fixed the numbers issue, while also making upgrading your damage a little more satisfying. 

Critical strike remains slightly better than damage in all difficulties.

notes.title: Update for 7/3b
notes.notes:
Added new difficulty settings (Easy, Medium, Hard).
Any old save file will be set to medium by default, this is the same difficulty that the game was before.
Any new save files will let you select a difficulty, once again if you like the difficulty as is, select medium.

New save files added so you can play around with the new difficulty settings if you're out of files.
In the future, auto save will be moved from save slot 5 to save slot 10. (your old auto save will still be in file 5).

notes.title: Fishing update 6/14
notes.notes:
The overall power of fishing in Ezerath has been much too high, in terms of farming for money, it should be in a good place, however the items obtained from fishing are much stronger than the options you can get in any other way, especially later in the game.

Fishing items have been nerfed across the board.
